photos.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: transparent photographic portrait for the Meet the Team section of AQUA TRIAX.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, not a style reference. Extract only the main central person in the photograph and remove the entire background, other people, building, motorbike, trees, sky, and all environmental objects.
Keep this exact real person's face, expression, skin tone, headwear, hair, body shape, clothing, original pose, yellow university jacket and patches unchanged. Do not synthesize a replacement face, beautify, retouch skin, change age, sharpen facial features artificially, add accessories, invent a pose or restyle clothing.
Composition: one upright portrait, centered, head to waist or the original available lower torso, retaining both shoulders and the original hands where available. Trim excessive empty space so the subject occupies roughly 88-94% of image height, with a small transparent margin above the head. Preserve natural photographic detail and edge transparency around hair and clothing.
The output must be a single isolated photographic cutout on a genuinely transparent alpha background. No backdrop, checkerboard painted into the image, frame, gradient, text, shadow or watermark.
Photo-specific invariant: Preserve her black hijab, crossed arms and original watch.
